title: BAASS Project Management Plan cover with logo over triangular craft rendering
description: Color cover page of the Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS) Project Management Plan (Overview Paper), Contract HHM402-08-C-0072, dated December 2, 2008. The full-page background is a digital rendering of a dark triangular craft with three glowing corner lights against a cloudy sky, beneath the stylized red-and-black BAASS logo with a swoosh and aircraft silhouette.
